spans.s:
a. [मुह्-घ अच् वा कुत्वम्] 
__1 Vain, useless, fruitless, unprofitable, unsuccessful; याच्ञा मोघा वरमधिगुणे नाधमे लब्धकामा [[

12.]] 
__2 Aimless, purposeless, indefinite. 
__3 Left, abandoned. 
__4 Idle. 
-घः A fence, an enclosure, a hedge. 
-घा The trumpet flower. 
-घम् ind. In vain, to no purpose, uselessly. 
-Comp. 
-कर्मन् a. engaging in useless rites. 
-पुष्पा a barren woman.
Den. Ā. To become useless or insignificant.
